title: CPU process sampling
responsibility: Reads aggregate CPU counters and a bounded process table, then returns the CPU sample with recognized process roles.

outputs.name: CpuProcessAdapter.sample
outputs.description: Resolves to a CPU reading with a monotonic timestamp from performance.now(), summed per-processor idle and total counters, the processor count, and process rows parsed from UTF-8 ps output. Sampling is available only on darwin and linux; ps collection has a 3-second timeout and 4 MiB output cap, and the promise rejects if ps fails or cpus() returns no processors.

errors.name: Unsupported CPU process platform
errors.description: sample throws Error('Unsupported CPU process platform.') before running ps when platform() is neither darwin nor linux.

errors.name: CPU counters unavailable
errors.description: sample throws Error('CPU counters unavailable.') after the ps call when cpus() returns an empty list.

errors.name: Bounded process-table command failure
errors.description: sample propagates a rejection from the awaited BoundedCommandAdapter.checked call, which runs ps with a 3-second timeout, a 4 MiB output cap, and LC_ALL=C.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: sample throws Error('Unsupported CPU process platform.') when platform() is neither darwin nor linux, before running ps. It throws Error('CPU counters unavailable.') when cpus() returns an empty list, after ps completes.
